newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Marsman declares 100 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Marsman declares 100 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Marsman & Company Inc said on Tuesday its board declared a 100 percent stock dividend worth 306 million pesos.
It said the record date will be set after the Securities and Exchange Commission approves the increase in authorised capital stock to 1.65 billion pesos from 450 million pesos.
Last year, the company granted a 0.125-peso cash dividend for each share. These totalled 38.3 million pesos.
Marsman is engaged in the manufacture, importation, distribution of drugs, pharmaceuticals, consumer products, hospital equipment and insurance.
